primary_key.rationale: Time-ordered UUIDs cluster well in B-tree indexes (unlike v4) and avoid index hot-spots that BIGSERIAL would create under high write rate. Single PK strategy across all tables keeps the migration generator and entity generator uniform.

extensions_required.name: uuid-ossp
extensions_required.purpose: Provides uuid_generate_v4 fallback and is required by some uuid_v7 implementations.

extensions_required.name: pgcrypto
extensions_required.purpose: gen_random_uuid() used in seed migrations; some uuid_v7 implementations build on it.

extensions_required.name: pg_trgm
extensions_required.purpose: Trigram indexes for substring search on names, codes and descriptions.

column_types.name: monetary
column_types.description: Money amounts (BRL). 13 digits before the decimal handles totals well into the billions, 2 decimals match centavos.

column_types.name: quantity
column_types.description: Item quantities. 4 decimals accommodate fractional units (kg, m³, hours).

column_types.name: unit_price
column_types.description: Unit prices that may have sub-cent precision (e.g. tax rates applied per unit).

column_types.name: percentage
column_types.description: Percentages 0..100 with 2 decimals. Always validated with CHECK (col BETWEEN 0 AND 100).

column_types.name: tenant_id_slug
column_types.description: Tenant id slug like 'emp_alpha' (matches schema name).

column_types.name: code_short
column_types.description: Short codes (UFs, CFOPs, status enums, numbered identifiers like 'ORC-2026-00042').

schema_annotation.description: First line of every DDL block declares its target schema. be-migration-generator routes the block to db/migration/<schema>/V<N>__<module>_<description>.sql accordingly.

fk_rule.logical_fk_description: Cross-schema FK uses a UUID column WITHOUT REFERENCES; referential integrity is enforced in the application service (with a lookup that fails with not_found before persisting).
fk_rule.rationale: Postgres does support cross-schema FK in principle but it complicates per-tenant schema lifecycle (drop, restore, migration). Logical FK with service-level validation keeps schemas independently movable.

snapshot_pattern.description: Fields suffixed with _snapshot are immutable once the parent aggregate transitions to a closed state. Enforced in the application service (rejects updates) and in the cancellation policy (cancellation creates a new immutable record rather than mutating the original).
